# BeatGig — account brief

## Who
BeatGig is a live music booking platform connecting artists with venues, colleges, and private events ([source](https://beatgig.com/)). Its GitHub org points at beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is committed in beatgig/beatgig-mobile ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The org has 6 public repos and 22 followers ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).
- beatgig-mobile last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)).
- The iOS app has 1,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).
- 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@beatgig-maintainer-1), top contributor to beatgig/beatgig-mobile with 88 commits ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). No title or location is listed.
- Maintainer Two (@beatgig-maintainer-2), 19 commits to beatgig/beatgig-mobile ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). No title or location is listed.

## Why now
The repo was last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)) and the app has shipped 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). It is on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer One — you have 88 commits in beatgig-mobile ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)), and it builds through EAS on React Native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)). Two App Store releases went out in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). When a booking bug reaches the 1,800 people who rated the app ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)), does the fix go out over the air, or does it wait for the next store review?
